name: CRH380A 动车（M 车，轴箱体 + 轮对纵向自由度）

layout.note: wheelsets carry the longitudinal coordinate too (4x6 = 24); the contact patch then moves along the track by that coordinate and the creep rate by its velocity

baseline.note: 静载门与八接触峰值来自 case_full12_cap05 / out_full12_cap05；换车后必须重建

physics_validation_status: unvalidated_against_measurement_or_Simpack; longitudinal wheelset coordinate added 2026-10-25 so the axle-box longitudinal channel is excited by creep, not by nothing

provenance.carbody.mass_kg: case_A_final_law.json（继承自 CHANGELOG_DOCS 第 12 轮之前的标定工作）
provenance.carbody.roll_inertia_kg_m2: 同上（算例内声明值，未与图纸逐项核对）
provenance.wheelset.mass_kg: 同上（1780 kg，与 CRE 轮对名义值同量级）
provenance.contact.effective_modulus_pa: 不在本文件里：接触律属于算例，见 case_*.json 的 contact 块

not_verified: wheelset longitudinal x is prescribed by the travel speed, not solved
bump stops, gearbox links and the vertical damper's series stiffness are not assembled
the sixth coordinate is unvalidated against measurement or Simpack output
车体/转向架/轮对的惯性张量只声明了三个方向，缺 Ixy/Ixz/Iyz 交叉项
一系二系只声明 k_y/k_z/k_yaw 与对应阻尼，无 k_x、无侧滚/点头刚度
无轴箱、无止挡、无抗蛇行减振器
carbody x freedom and carbody pitch/yaw coupling to the bogies are recorded here but not solved: the current layout has no longitudinal degree of freedom
the anti-roll bar, traction rod, lateral damper, bump stop and axle-box bushings are recorded geometry and stiffness only - none of them is assembled into the solver yet

carbody-mounted points on the left and right side are recorded as half-widths from the model's own subvariables; the Simpack model stores |y| per side, so sign conventions must be re-derived per element before assembly
轴箱体只插在垂向/横向载荷路径上：一系弹簧与转臂节点改为 轴箱↔构架，轮对↔轴箱取轴承刚体 1e9 N/m；一系点头约束仍留在 构架↔轮对，所以高频段与 5-DOF 车型必然不同
轮对纵向自由度用 1e8 N/m 的轴承刚度接到轴箱，再用 13.7e6 N/m 的转臂节点接到构架；真实轴箱轴承的轴向刚度远高于此，取 1e8 是为了与垂向/横向保持同一量级而不是标定值
整车纵向是自由的（构架-车体只由 7.88e6 N/m 牵引拉杆相连），所以存在一个零频刚体纵向模态；算例给定恒速时这一模态不应被激励，但长时间窗下纵向位置可以漂移

frame.x: carbody reference point; the model's own carbody position is 13.5 m
frame.y: track centreline, positive to the right (the Simpack model stores |y| per side)
frame._note: Simpack stores absolute z from the rail top; we keep the same convention here so a value can be copied without a silent offset

elements.name: train_x
elements.note: The rest of the train.  With x free the vehicle is a free body in the longitudinal direction: any unbalanced creep force accelerates it and the run drifts until a wheel climbs the flange.  This grounded spring-damper holds the mean longitudinal position at the prescribed speed, so only relative motion is integrated.
